list.title: Frontend Development
list.description: Modern, responsive, and accessible interfaces built with React, Next.js, and TypeScript — optimized for performance and user experience.
list.details: Production-grade frontends are developed using React, Next.js, and TypeScript with Tailwind CSS for responsive and elegant design. Real-time interactions are enabled through Pusher and Firebase, supported by code-splitting, lazy loading, and accessibility standards. Each interface is optimized for speed, usability, and visual consistency across all devices and browsers.

list.title: Backend Development
list.description: Scalable, secure, and maintainable server-side systems using Python (FastAPI, Django) and Node.js with clean architecture principles.
list.details: Backend solutions are designed with Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask) and Node.js (Express.js) following modular and scalable patterns. RESTful and GraphQL APIs are implemented with authentication (JWT) and authorization layers, supported by caching and asynchronous processing for optimal performance and reliability.

list.title: API & Database Architecture
list.description: Efficient API design and optimized database schemas ensuring reliability, scalability, and fast data access.
list.details: RESTful and GraphQL APIs are designed with clear documentation, versioning, and validation layers. Database architectures leverage PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis with indexing and query optimization techniques to enhance performance, reduce latency, and maintain data integrity across systems.

list.title: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
list.description: Automated deployments, cloud scalability, and continuous delivery pipelines ensuring reliability and uptime.
list.details: Deployment pipelines are automated using Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration. GitHub Actions powers CI/CD workflows, with Nginx configured for load balancing and reverse proxying. Infrastructure-as-Code principles ensure reproducibility, while monitoring and alerting systems maintain 99.9% uptime and efficient resource utilization.

projects.title: My Latest Work
projects.subtitle: I worked on various projects that involve building full-stack applications. I'm always looking for opportunities to collaborate with talented developers and teams.

list.title: Diraya Law Firm
list.description: Built the entire bilingual platform for a Riyadh corporate law firm — frontend, backend, and database. Includes a full CMS for legal articles and insights, a consultation-booking flow, and an automated legal-insights newsletter.
list.stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS SES, SSR, i18n (Arabic/English)
list.problem: Diraya, a corporate law firm in Riyadh, needed a bilingual digital presence with a real publishing workflow for legal insights and a reliable way to convert website visitors into booked consultations — not just a static brochure site.
list.solution: Designed and built the platform solo end-to-end: a Next.js/React frontend with Arabic/English SSR, a Node.js backend, and a PostgreSQL/MongoDB data layer. Shipped a full CMS dashboard for publishing legal articles and announcements, a consultation-booking flow, and an automated legal-insights newsletter via AWS SES.
list.impact: Gave the firm a self-service CMS to publish content without developer involvement, a working consultation pipeline, and a bilingual, SEO-optimized site built for performance from day one.

list.title: HomaApp
list.description: A production-ready luxury property platform I architected and built from scratch for HOMA — real-time messaging via Pusher, push notifications via Firebase, and a fully responsive design optimized for performance. I now lead product for HomaApp as Technical Product Manager while staying hands-on, with an 8-person team.
list.stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Query, Pusher, Firebase, Docker
list.problem: HOMA needed a modern, scalable luxury property platform that could handle real-time interactions, provide seamless user experience, and be production-ready with optimal performance.
list.solution: Built a comprehensive platform using Next.js and React with real-time features via Pusher and Firebase. Implemented mobile-first responsive design, containerized with Docker for scalable deployment, and optimized performance through code splitting and lazy loading.
list.impact: Delivered a production-ready platform with real-time capabilities, improved user engagement through instant notifications, and 40% faster deployment through containerization. Now leading the product as Technical Product Manager, owning BRDs, PRDs, and roadmap for an 8-person cross-functional team.

list.title: Caro
list.description: End-to-end car-rental system for a Riyadh company: customer booking flow, fleet catalog, seasonal offers, and an admin dashboard with full booking management. WhatsApp Business API automates booking approval/rejection notifications.
list.stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Motion.dev, Node.js, WhatsApp Business API, SSR
list.problem: A Riyadh car-rental company needed a modern booking platform to replace manual, phone-based reservations — plus a way to manage fleet, seasonal pricing, and customer communication without a large ops team.
list.solution: Built the full platform solo: a customer-facing booking flow with fleet catalog and seasonal offers, an admin dashboard for full booking management and admin-controlled dynamic settings, marketing popups, and WhatsApp Business API integration for automated approval/rejection notifications. SEO built Arabic-first.
list.impact: Replaced manual phone bookings with a self-service flow, gave the ops team a single dashboard to manage the entire fleet and bookings, and automated customer notifications end-to-end via WhatsApp.

list.title: Elite Experts
list.description: Bilingual platform for a crisis-management, risk, and security consulting firm — frontend and backend, an internal project-management dashboard, advanced technical SEO, and NodeMailer email pipelines for client inquiries.
list.stack: Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, NodeMailer, SSR, i18n (Arabic/English)
list.problem: Elite Experts, a crisis-management and security consulting firm, needed a professional bilingual website plus internal tooling to track client projects, and a technical SEO strategy to be found for high-intent consulting searches.
list.solution: Built the frontend and backend, an internal project-management dashboard for the team, and NodeMailer email pipelines for client and consultation inquiries. Led keyword research and content planning as part of an advanced technical SEO pass.
list.impact: Delivered a bilingual public site backed by internal tooling the team actually uses to track engagements, plus a technical SEO foundation aimed at qualified consulting leads.

list.title: Ijar
list.description: Ijar simplifies rentals, whether you're sharing your car or need one. If your car's idle and you want extra cash, or you need a ride for the weekend, Ijar connects owners and renters easily, making the process effortless.
list.stack: Express.js, React, MongoDB, Node.js, ShadCN, PayPal API, Tailwind CSS
list.problem: Car rental processes are often complicated, expensive, and time-consuming. Many car owners have idle vehicles while renters struggle to find affordable, convenient options.
list.solution: Ijar provides a peer-to-peer car rental platform that connects car owners with renters directly, eliminating middlemen and reducing costs. The platform features secure payments via PayPal, real-time availability, and user verification.
list.impact: Simplified the rental process, reduced costs by 30%, and created a new income stream for car owners. The platform processes 1,000+ monthly transactions and has facilitated hundreds of successful rentals.

list.title: Awamer Website Development
list.description: Developed a comprehensive website for Awamer for Communications & IT, showcasing their services in cybersecurity, software development, and IT consulting. Full-stack development with modern UX/UI design and enhanced user experience.
list.stack: Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadCn, Motion.dev
list.problem: Awamer needed a modern, professional website to showcase their comprehensive IT services including cybersecurity, software development, and IT consulting to potential clients.
list.solution: Built a full-stack website using Next.js and React with modern UX/UI design principles. Integrated shadCn components and Motion.dev for smooth animations, implemented responsive design with Tailwind CSS, and optimized for performance and SEO.
list.impact: Delivered a professional, high-performance website that effectively showcases Awamer's services, improves client engagement, and establishes strong online presence in the IT consulting market.

list.title: AudioTube
list.description: AudioTube makes listening to YouTube content effortless. Stream or download YouTube videos as audio, saving data and storage space. Ideal for music, podcasts, AudioTube works seamlessly even with slow internet.
list.stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Python, Flask, YouTubeDL, FFmpeg
list.problem: Users want to listen to YouTube content without video, but downloading entire videos wastes data and storage. Existing solutions are often complicated or require subscriptions.
list.solution: AudioTube extracts audio from YouTube videos on-demand, allowing users to stream or download audio-only files. Built with Python Flask backend and React frontend, it uses YouTubeDL and FFmpeg for efficient audio extraction.
list.impact: Reduced data usage by up to 80%, saved storage space, and provided a free alternative to premium services. Users can enjoy content offline without video overhead.
